owner_and_capability: #4075: Delivery Platform retains mail branding, request-decision delivery, absence notifications and group invalidations. Enrollment, Organisation & Tenancy, School Structure, People Directory and Communication consume root-bound ports; tests verify wire and Settings capability contracts rather than foreign implementation vocabulary.
affected_tables: None: no schema, table ownership or SQL change.
atomic_cutover: Root wiring switches the callers to consumer-owned ports in the same change as their implementation imports and all ten legacy keys are deleted. Delivery keeps the existing event builders, branding functions, consent filters, notification window checks and durable enqueue calls. Composition binds the existing provider transaction adapter from its owned Postgres package. No new rules, type aliases or exceptions; budgets do not increase.
tests: Affected Go suites via scripts/run-go-toolchain.sh scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast.

Communication TestRequestDecisionEnqueueFailuresAbortTheUnitOfWork; School Structure TestAdditionalSupervisionSignalsOnlyAfterCommit and TestGroupHandoverSignalsOnlyAfterCommit; People Directory TestStaffAbsenceNotificationCallbacks.
Delivery registry-key contract tests resolve the real Settings capability; school portal HTTP preference assertions and API production router golden are preserved.
